page.overview:
Who is Bavris?

Bavris was a general in the Grand Army of the Republic. In the early stages of the Clone Wars, Bavris won praise from his men and Republic politicians for posting a bounty on the location and capture of Separatist equipment, a bounty that led directly to the apprehension of the crawl-carrier development facility on Dagro.
